name: prompt-390
image_purpose: Create a playful fashion lookbook portrait with retro toy styling.

prompt.project_info: A full-body photorealistic Fairy Kei studio portrait of an original adult East Asian woman.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult East Asian woman with rainbow pastel wig hair, large excited eyes, natural skin texture, and a huge joyful smile. She wears layered pastel T-shirts, a pink tutu skirt, colorful striped leg warmers, pastel high-top sneakers, plastic jewelry, and a large bow in her hair.
prompt.composition_elements: High-energy mid-jump or one-leg-popped pose with arms up and peace signs, full-body framing, pastel-pink wall, retro toys such as My Little Pony and Care Bears, and vinyl records in the hyper-colorful studio.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright even pop lighting from on-axis beauty dish or ring flash, side softboxes eliminating harsh shadows, simple top light, ring catchlights, high-key flat magazine-pop style.
prompt.technical_specs: Full-frame 35mm lens, f/4, 1/125s, ISO 200, 5000K white balance, eye-detect focus, photorealistic fabric, accessory, skin, and toy texture, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a full-body photorealistic Fairy Kei studio portrait of an original adult East Asian woman with rainbow pastel wig hair, large excited eyes, natural skin texture, and a huge joyful smile. Dress her in layered pastel T-shirts, a pink tutu skirt, colorful striped leg warmers, pastel high-top sneakers, excessive plastic jewelry, and a large bow in her hair. Use a hyper-colorful studio with a pastel-pink wall decorated with retro toys such as My Little Pony and Care Bears and vinyl records. Pose her mid-jump or with one leg popped high, arms raised and making peace signs. Use bright even pop lighting from an on-axis beauty dish or ring flash, side softboxes, simple top light, ring catchlight, full-frame 35mm f/4, 5000K, high-key pastel-pop color, and photorealistic texture.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, nudity, sexualized pose, underage look, anime, cartoon, plastic doll skin, warped hands, extra fingers, deformed limbs, dark colors, gothic mood, sad expression, text, logos, watermark

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No external reference is required for this text-derived template. Preserve one original adult East Asian woman, rainbow pastel wig, pastel layered outfit, tutu, leg warmers, sneakers, bow, retro toys, vinyl records, high-energy pose, and bright Fairy Kei lighting. Do not add readable logos or text.
